Name: (AT)(FF) Island Resort Furniture
Author: Ignifex
Description:
[b]If you're using Alternative Textures for the Beach Towels:[/b]

The beach towels replace the burlap rug and the oceanic rug via AT.



[b]If you're using Furniture Framework for the Beach Towels and Umbrellas:[/b]

The shadows underneath the beach umbrellas can be walked on! (Made possible by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458?tab=description]Furniture Framework[/url]). You can buy beach towels and umbrellas at Robin's at no cost or use the CJB Item Spawner.

The sprites used were extracted in the vanilla tilesheets.


How to install:
1. Unzip the file into the Mods folder.



Note: This is the first mod that I published so please let me know if you encounter any issues! Happy decorating!



Also tysm for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/87388223]Leroymilo[/url] for making the framework and kindly answering my questions!
